verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs show clear AI-native positioning — PyAirbyte for AI/Python developers, MCP servers connecting agents like Claude/Cursor to synced data, and marketing copy about equipping agents to 'query, search, and act on your data in real-time' and connecting systems to an 'inference and analytics layer' — plus a community mention of users piping synced data into a local vector db. However, there is no explicit documentation in the pack naming vector-store destinations (e.g., Pinecone/Weaviate/Chroma) or describing chunking/embedding/LLM-ready formatting, so the core mechanics of the story are only implied, not directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit vector-store destination docs, embedding/chunking pipeline details, and independent/hands-on confirmation that synced data lands correctly in a vector store for agent retrieval.
